t2.thesis: RIOT enters earnings after a roughly 33-40% monthly drawdown with a sector-wide lease-financing scare, which offers some mean-reversion and short-covering potential but no clear edge over the buy-everything base rate for an open-to-open hold on a stock with a 16% implied move.
reasons: Base rate of about 54% for buying all events, 54.8% for BMO, with no usable cluster data for crypto proxies.
Stock is down about 40% in a month and 59% from its 52-week high, on sector financing fears and a Keefe Bruyette target cut, which leaves low expectations and room for relief.
The entry-to-exit window includes the earnings gap at the exit open, so the result depends on the print itself, with a large implied move of 16% and no directional skew.
Put-heavy volume (put/call volume 1.6) and negative EPS revisions are mild negatives, while the last four prints all gained, though that sample is small and the stock has changed.
t2.deciding_variable: Whether management gives credible financing and timing updates on the 191 MW lease and Corsicana data center leasing, and whether the market reads them as de-risking, against weak Q3 mining numbers and bitcoin direction.

prior.from: I3 overall validation hit 0.542, BMO 0.548; crypto_proxy cluster (n=8) is insufficient so ignored

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. Today is 2026-11-02, so the November 4, 2026 earnings report hasn't happened yet, and I have no information about how RIOT's stock reacted to it.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down about 0.04 from 0.54 to 0.50: bearish crypto and sector tape, negative estimate revisions and put-heavy flow offset oversold mean-reversion and the record of positive past reactions.

theses.mechanism: Oversold stock with short interest of about 15.5% reacts to clarity on investment-grade backstop and new tenant progress, so shorts cover
theses.wrong_if: Management is vague on financing or the timing of Corsicana leasing, or announces dilution

theses.expected: Decline on weak mining results and sector overhang
theses.mechanism: Revenue and loss miss from higher costs and network difficulty, plus the lease catalyst drought narrative, extend the sector selloff
theses.wrong_if: Mining results and data center revenue beat, and the call is upbeat on new leases

theses.expected: Muted or mixed open dominated by bitcoin moves
theses.mechanism: Stock trades with bitcoin and the miner basket between entry and exit opens, so the print is a smaller factor than crypto beta
theses.wrong_if: Bitcoin is stable and the stock gaps strongly on company-specific news

key_observations: Update on financing and the investment-grade credit backstop for the 191 MW lease
New lease announcements or tenant pipeline at Corsicana
Data center and engineering revenue versus the loss estimate of about -$0.31
Bitcoin price move and miner basket pre-market on Nov 4
AMD Phase 3 delivery in November 2026 on schedule
